testsuite.name: ElectricalServiceSecurityTests

testcase.name: Technician 1 (assigned) sees the Service Request via find
Technician 2 (not assigned) does not see the Service Request via find
Technician 2 (not assigned) does not see the Service Request via get
Dispatcher sees the Service Request regardless of technician assignment
Technician cannot schedule a Visit (Dispatcher-only action)
unauthenticated caller cannot create a Service Request
